jobs.description: About Agent F Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention. Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control. We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. These founding roles will shape both the product and the way we build it. About the role You will own how customers experience Agent F, from landing pages and product demonstrations through onboarding and migration to the work they do every day. A founder looking at their finances for the first time and a controller investigating a discrepancy need different levels of detail. Both should understand where they are, what a number means and what to do next. This combines product design with hands-on front-end engineering.
